Title: Core Functional Test: Verify Product Type Detection for SODA
Description: Validate that the system correctly identifies a product as SODA when D1 sensor detects an object within 250 units and D2 sensor is inactive.
Objective: Ensure correct product type detection for SODA based on defined sensor logic
Comments: This test covers positive case with valid sensor inputs

Title: Boundary Value Analysis Test: Validate Sensor Inputs at Threshold Limit
Description: Test system behavior when sensor inputs are exactly at the 250 unit threshold to ensure correct product type detection and gripper action.
Objective: Validate boundary conditions for distance sensor inputs
Comments: Tests exact boundary values of 250 units

Title: User Input Validation Test: Validate Sensor Input Range
Description: Test system behavior with valid, invalid, and edge-case sensor inputs to ensure proper validation and handling of user data.
Objective: Validate input validation for distance sensor values
Comments: Includes boundary and out-of-range inputs

Title: Boundary Value Analysis Test: Validate Sensor Inputs Just Below Threshold
Description: Test system behavior when sensor inputs are just below the 250 unit threshold to ensure correct product type detection and gripper action.
Objective: Validate boundary conditions for distance sensor inputs
Comments: Tests values slightly under 250 units

Title: Verify Gripper Closure for SODA Product Detection at 249 Units
Description: This test verifies that the gripper closes correctly when sensor D1 detects a product at 249 units, which is below the 250-unit threshold for SODA type detection.
Objective: Validate proper gripper behavior and state transition for SODA product detection
Comments: Ensures correct identification of SODA product type based on sensor input

Title: Test Gripper Closure with Invalid Input (Above 250 Units)
Description: Validate that the gripper does not close when sensor D1 detects more than 250 units, ensuring correct product type identification.
Objective: Ensure system does not misidentify non-SODA products as SODA
Comments: Tests error handling for invalid input values

Title: Test Error Recovery During Gripper Closure for SODA Detection
Description: Simulate interruption or error during gripper closure process and verify that the system handles recovery appropriately.
Objective: Validate error recovery mechanisms during gripper operation
Comments: Tests robustness of gripper control under fault conditions

Title: Verify Gripper Closure with No Product Detected (Sensor D1 = 0)
Description: Test system behavior when sensor D1 reports no product detected, ensuring that gripper does not close unnecessarily.
Objective: Validate system response to absence of product detection
Comments: Ensures correct handling of null or zero input values

Title: Core Functional Test: Gripper Behavior for WATER Product Detection
Description: Verify that the gripper correctly identifies and responds to a WATER product when sensor D2 detects less than 250 units, ensuring proper state transition to WATER.
Objective: Validate correct gripper behavior and system state transition for WATER product detection
Comments: Ensure gripper action aligns with WATER product type requirements

Title: Boundary Value Analysis: Sensor D2 at Upper Boundary for WATER Detection
Description: Test the gripper behavior when sensor D2 detects exactly 250 units, which is the upper limit for WATER product identification.
Objective: Validate system response at boundary condition of 250 units
Comments: Ensure no misidentification occurs at boundary value

Title: User Input Validation Test: Invalid Sensor Data for WATER Product
Description: Test the system's response to invalid sensor inputs such as negative values or non-numeric data when attempting to identify a WATER product.
Objective: Validate input validation and error handling for invalid sensor readings
Comments: Ensure appropriate error messages are displayed for invalid inputs

Title: Positive Test: Gripper Behavior with Valid WATER Product at 249 Units
Description: Confirm that the gripper performs the correct action when sensor D2 detects a valid WATER product at 249 units, ensuring proper state transition.
Objective: Validate correct gripper behavior for valid WATER product detection
Comments: Ensure full functionality is preserved for valid inputs

Title: Verify System Response to No Product Detected by Sensor D1
Description: Validate that the system correctly identifies a NONE product type when sensor D1 does not detect any product, ensuring the gripper remains open and appropriate status is logged.
Objective: Ensure correct identification of NONE product type when sensor D1 fails to detect an object
Comments: Precondition: Sensor D1 must be simulated as inactive or returning no detection signal

Title: Verify Gripper State When No Product is Detected (NONE)
Description: Test that the gripper remains in an open state when no product is detected by either sensor, confirming correct handling of NONE product type.
Objective: Validate gripper behavior for NONE product type detection
Comments: Ensure gripper does not close or perform any action related to product handling

Title: Verify System Response to Both Sensors Returning No Detection
Description: Validate that the system correctly identifies a NONE product type when both sensors D1 and D2 fail to detect any object.
Objective: Ensure consistent handling of NONE state across multiple sensor failures
Comments: Test case covers scenario where both sensors are inactive or return no detection

Title: Verify User Input Validation for Sensor Status
Description: Validate that the system correctly interprets user inputs related to sensor status and handles invalid or malformed input appropriately.
Objective: Ensure robustness of sensor status interpretation under various inputs
Comments: Test with valid, invalid, and edge-case sensor status values

Title: Core Functional Test - Handle Conflicting Sensor Readings
Description: Verify that the system correctly identifies and handles conflicting sensor inputs (e.g., D1 and D2 near threshold) by maintaining a stable state and avoiding incorrect gripper actions.
Objective: Validate core functionality for handling ambiguous sensor data
Comments: Ensure no unintended gripper movement occurs during conflict resolution

Title: Error Recovery Test - Invalid Sensor Data Handling
Description: Simulate invalid sensor readings (e.g., out-of-range or erratic values) and verify that the system properly logs errors, maintains safe state, and recovers gracefully without crashing.
Objective: Assess error recovery mechanisms under invalid input conditions
Comments: Ensure system does not crash or enter undefined behavior

Title: Negative Test - No Sensor Data Received
Description: Test system behavior when no sensor data is received from either D1 or D2, ensuring that the system appropriately handles missing inputs and logs errors.
Objective: Validate handling of missing sensor input data
Comments: Ensure error logging and safe state maintenance

Title: Error Logging Test - Conflicting Inputs
Description: Confirm that the system logs detailed error messages when conflicting sensor data is detected, including timestamps and input values for diagnostic purposes.
Objective: Validate accurate and comprehensive error logging
Comments: Ensure log entries contain sufficient context for debugging

Title: Verify System Initialization with Sensors Enabled and Gripper Open
Description: This test case ensures that the robot initializes correctly with all sensors enabled and the gripper in an open state before product detection logic begins. It validates hardware readiness and system preconditions.
Objective: Validate correct system initialization with proper sensor and gripper states
Comments: Precondition: Robot is powered on and connected to control system

Title: Test Error Recovery During Sensor Initialization Failure
Description: Simulate a sensor initialization failure and verify that the system properly handles the error, logs the issue, and attempts recovery or alerts the operator.
Objective: Validate error handling and recovery mechanisms during sensor init failure
Comments: Simulate hardware fault in one of the sensors

Title: Test System Readiness Check After Reinitialization
Description: After a system reset or reinitialization, verify that all preconditions are revalidated and the system is ready for product detection logic execution.
Objective: Validate system readiness post-reinitialization
Comments: Post-reset scenario: sensors must re-enable and gripper must re-open

Title: Test Boundary Value for Gripper Open Position
Description: Validate the gripper's behavior at the boundary of its open position, ensuring it correctly recognizes when fully open and handles slight deviations.
Objective: Ensure correct operation at gripper open boundary
Comments: Test values: 99%, 100% (fully open), 101%

Title: Verify Core Functional Behavior at Exact Boundary Value of 250 Units
Description: This test case verifies that the system correctly interprets a distance sensor input of exactly 250 units as product detection, ensuring proper behavior at the defined boundary condition.
Objective: Validate correct interpretation of sensor input at exact boundary value (250 units)
Comments: Ensure no misinterpretation occurs at the threshold boundary

Title: Verify Boundary Value Analysis for Input Just Above Threshold (251 Units)
Description: Test that a sensor input of 251 units is correctly interpreted as no product detected, validating the upper boundary behavior.
Objective: Validate correct handling of inputs just above the threshold
Comments: Ensure system does not treat 251 as product detected

Title: Validate User Input Validation at Boundary Conditions with Invalid Data Types
Description: Test the system's response to invalid inputs such as null, non-numeric strings, or out-of-range values near the boundary (e.g., 250.001, -100).
Objective: Ensure proper validation and error handling for invalid inputs at boundary conditions
Comments: Test robustness against malformed data

Title: Test Boundary Condition with Minimum Allowed Input (249.001)
Description: Validate that an input slightly below the boundary but within acceptable tolerance (e.g., 249.001) is treated as product detected.
Objective: Ensure correct behavior for inputs near but under boundary limits
Comments: Confirm system sensitivity at lower boundary

Title: Verify Gripper Grasp and Release for SODA Product
Description: Validate that the gripper correctly identifies a SODA product and performs appropriate grasp and release actions based on product type.
Objective: Ensure correct gripper behavior for SODA product identification
Comments: Test covers successful manipulation with valid product type

Title: Verify Gripper Manipulation with Invalid Product Type
Description: Validate system behavior when an invalid or unrecognized product type is identified, ensuring appropriate error handling and gripper state management.
Objective: Test error recovery for unrecognized product types
Comments: Includes invalid input simulation and error response validation

Title: Verify Gripper Behavior at Boundary of Product Size Range
Description: Test gripper performance when handling products at the minimum and maximum size boundaries for SODA and WATER categories.
Objective: Validate boundary conditions for product size inputs
Comments: Applies boundary value analysis to product dimensions

Title: Verify Gripper Input Validation for Product Identification
Description: Validate system's ability to handle various inputs for product identification including valid, invalid, and edge-case values.
Objective: Ensure robust input validation for product type recognition
Comments: Tests multiple input scenarios for robustness
